slug: 当不成赘婿就只好命格成圣

第10章少年气度，伏如虎卧，起如龙舞
近秋的中午，太阳仍然不能完全褪去夏日的炽热。
一阵微风吹过，却能轻易的带起几分凉意。
盛姿提着那一盒十分珍贵的桃花酥，和陆漪一同来到陆景的小院之前。
这位处神霄伯府西院的小院，对比府中其它陆府子弟的院落，幽静了许多，也寒酸了许多。
门口就只有一棵松树。
可这一棵松树，不同于日渐凋零的其他树木，叶子依然油亮，就好像是一座宝塔一样，威严屹立在那里。
盛姿和陆漪明显对于这棵松树不感兴趣。
陆漪对于盛姿打算将珍贵而有好吃的桃花酥送给陆景这件事情，其实颇有微词。
碍于这桃花酥本来就是宁老太君送给盛姿的，她也不好说些什么。
只是嘴里还在嘟囔：“桃花酥这般珍贵，送给陆景岂不是可惜了……”
盛姿对于陆漪的埋怨，明显不甚在意，而是朝着那一处小院张望。
小院大门并没有紧闭。
隔着极远的距离，透过用来遮丑的桐树屏障罅隙，盛姿清楚的看到院中的景象。
小院里种了许多不知是从何处移栽过来的花草，一个丫鬟正在俯身打理。
这些花草并不名贵，却被打理的极好，长势也极为旺盛，即便去近秋，也有花朵盛开，给那老旧的小院带来几分温馨。
不大的院落中，也摆放着在西院随处可见的石桌石凳。
“陆景正在练字？”
盛姿看到石桌前，陆景的身影，心生好奇。
一旁的陆漪却突然噗嗤一笑，说道：“我看父亲大人写字之前，总是沐浴更衣，凝神静气，书桌一尘不染。”

“可是这陆景倒好，竟然边吃边写。”
并如同陆漪所说。
在一张草纸旁边，还摆放着一盘寻常的青菜。
陆景每写几个字，就要将毛笔递到左手，拿起筷子吃上几口，显得十分随意。
盛姿并不在意这些。
即便她的父亲也曾教导过盛姿，对于学问要有敬畏之心。
然而盛姿前来此地有自己的目的，他人行事，又与她无关，自然不会去评判什么。
“陆漪，我今天有求于你这景三哥，你莫要没大没小，惹怒了他。”
陆漪微微怔然，眼中泛起几分疑惑。
盛姿有求于陆景？
盛家在这太玄京中，权势惊人。
盛姿的父亲乃是太枢阁次辅大臣，这是朝中举足轻重，说一句叱咤风云，呼风唤雨也不为过。
有着这等门楣的盛姿，有求于陆景？
“这陆景又能帮到你什么？盛姐姐，不如伱告诉我原由，我来替你想法子？”
盛姿摇头道：“许多东西可遇不可求，能够轻易找到的也就不是什么珍贵的东西了。”
陆漪似懂非懂，两条马尾还在脑后晃荡，她回过神来，翘起下巴：“既然如此，盛姐姐不妨把这件事交给我，我在府中说话向来是管用的。”
“盛姐姐只需告诉我，你想要从陆景那里要些什么，我与陆景说，他不敢不给。”
陆漪说话的时候，眼睛中还带着几分狡黠的得色。
盛姿却皱了皱眉头。
原本就英气四溢的面容上带起不悦之色。

“陆漪。”盛姿正色道：“昨日钟夫人考校你这景三哥，我观他一言一行，气度不凡，又带着许多锋锐之气。
我觉得他虽然在陆府中不得宠，却并非是什么能够随意折辱的懦弱少年。
而且他又是你兄长，你在他面前那般盛气凌人，只怕不妥。”
陆漪听到盛姿郑重的话语，明显有些愣神。
盛姿却不曾再给她说话的机会，朝着那小院走去的同时，又对陆漪道：“进了院里，你不要出声。”
陆漪回过神来，眼中明显带着些许的不服气，可又并不愿反驳盛姿，便只能垂头丧气的跟在盛姿身后。
两人来到门前，陆景还在埋头写字。
那一只有些许褪色的毛笔，游走在草纸上，竟然颇有几分快意。
“少爷，门前来人了。”
原本正在低头操持那些花草的青玥看到盛姿、陆漪二人。
连忙拍去手上的尘土，站起身来。
此时，正是陆景落下的最后一笔。
他长长吐出一口气，放下手中毛笔，这才抬头看向门外。
大门动开，陆景当然察觉到门口来人了。
只是他最后一行诗句已经落笔，他前世所修的“草圣张旭”草书，又讲究一个落笔不辍，所以也就不曾停笔。
“青玥，沏茶。”
陆景唤了一声，青玥远远朝着来人行礼，又走进里屋，沏茶去了。
“陆漪妹妹，带着客人进来吧。”
陆景朝着陆漪点头，十分自然的开口。
盛姿顿觉哑然。

陆景语气沉静之余，竟然隐隐带着几分长辈的威严。
陆漪也同样如此，她张了张嘴，一时之间竟然不知要回些什么话好。
在这陆府之中，陆漪和她这个三堂哥从来不曾有过交流。
即便小时候贪玩的年纪，也跟着其它的兄弟姐妹，与陆景划下界限，最多只是在陆景被欺负的时候笑上几句。
可令陆漪没想到的是，陆景这一句“妹妹”竟然这般自然，而且语气里还带着理所当然。
就好像……平日里陆景在府中的角色，确实是一个被人信服的兄长那般。
“这陆景好生奇怪……谁是她妹妹？”
陆漪撇了撇嘴正要说些什么。
盛姿突然朝前一步，对陆漪道：“陆漪，你是东道，怎么不介绍一番？”
陆漪顿时泄气，不情不愿道：“陆景，这是十里长宁街最里边盛府的盛姿姐姐。”
“盛姿？”陆景面色不变，请两位姑娘进屋
心中却在揣测。
“原来这与陆漪一道的红衣少女并不是南禾雨？那一日，南府小姐昨日究竟是否前来府中？”
“这盛姿姑娘来找我，又是什么事？”
此时此刻的盛姿，并不曾面配轻纱。
她身材高挑，肤如凝脂，明媚皓齿，腰间还卷缠一条泛着青光的长鞭，看起来极为赏心悦目。
与其他正值年华的少女有所不同的是，盛姿气质中竟然透露出一股锐气，眉宇之间，也并没有丝毫柔弱，反而勾出一丝英气。
“咦……这字是景公子写的？”
在陆景思索的时候，盛姿和陆漪已经走到石桌前，原本她们想要越过石桌，走进屋子里。
只是路过石桌的时候，盛姿眼角瞥到陆景摊在桌上的草纸。

只见那草纸上写着几行词句。
笔墨虽偶有飘忽，但仔细看去，那笔迹却伏如虎卧，起如龙舞。
盛姿不懂书法，又觉得这草纸上的笔墨好像天生带着一种惊人的美感。
不过，在盛姿眼里这书法都是其次，真正引起她注意的，其实是那几行文字。
【道吾好者是吾贼，道吾恶者是吾师。
路逢侠客须呈剑，不是才人莫献诗。
三人同行，必有吾师焉。
择其善者而从之，其不善者而改之。】
短短四行笔墨，却让盛姿睁大眼睛，仔细揣摩着其中的深意。
转眼间，几息时间过去。
盛姿嘴里还在呢喃着那一句“路逢侠客须呈剑，不是才人莫献诗。”
“路上遇到侠客应当献上宝剑，不要向没有才学的人诵读诗篇。”
这四句文章，却好像充斥着人生哲理，又夹杂着极为浪漫洒脱的侠客情怀。
令本就好武，天生洒脱的盛姿分外喜欢。
“今天看到这四句文章，也算是不虚此行了。”
盛姿眼神清亮，心中不免有些懊悔：“这样的至理名言不知出自哪一本典籍，我今日才看到是我的遗憾。”
“陆景书写这四行文章，便也代表着他的心境大致也是如此。
理智之中又带着洒脱，又有敬重有德侠客的意思。”
“而且这一手笔墨也极为不凡……”
盛姿思绪翻涌间，又看到被摆放在桌案上的那一碟小青菜。

用来练字的纸笔也十分廉价。
“这毛笔不知用了多久，笔杆已经褪色泛白，有些许弯曲，这练字用的是更不是北洛道的河绸纸，甚至连柳宣纸都不是，不过是寻常人家读书所用的草纸。”
“还有那一盘青菜……”
盛姿心中叹息一声，这纸笔，这青菜放到寻常人家，倒也并没有特别之处。
可是这里是九湖陆府，眼前这位少年的生父是那位年轻时名动一时，被誉为九湖第一场风雨的神霄将军陆神远。
在这些身份的陪衬下，盛姿终于知道陆景的处境究竟有多么艰难。
“盛小姐……盛姿小姐？”
“盛姐姐！”
陆景和陆漪的轻呼让盛姿回过神来。
陆景和他不动声色。
陆漪却有些不解。
盛姐姐……这是怎么了？
“是我失神了。”
盛姿倒是十分自然，没有丝毫窘迫。
她转过头来凝视着陆景的眼眸，突然笑道：“我今日见这四行文章，只觉得颇为喜欢。
希望能向景公子讨要这一幅笔墨，最好能请公子标明出处，盛姿他日必有酬谢。”
盛姿落落大方，开口讨要这张草纸。
陆景却犯了难。
“标明出处？这世界有《增广贤文》吗？”
陆漪见陆景犹豫，顿时有些无语：“陆景，不过是一张纸而已，你还舍不得了？你要是舍不得，我那里有的是上好的河绸纸…”

陆漪原本趾高气扬的话语，忽然越说越没有底气，声音也逐渐小了下去。
因为不知何时，陆景已经微微侧头，神色没有丝毫变化，只是注视着陆漪的眼睛。
这一刻，陆漪不知为何，那一份来自于稚嫩少女的骄矜、高傲、咄咄逼人便无法保持下去了。
她的声音越来越小，直至说完这句话，低下脑袋。
陆景笑了笑，对一旁的盛姿道：“并非是舍不得一张草纸……只是这出处……”
他说到这里，微微摇头，拿起旁边的毛笔，又仔细蘸墨。
在最左侧写道……
“出自《增广贤文》。”
content_en:
Chapter 10: Youthful demeanor, lying down like a tiger, rising like a dancing dragon
At noon in late autumn, the sun still cannot completely fade away the heat of summer.
A breeze blew by, but it could easily bring a bit of coolness.
Sheng Zi carried the box of very precious peach blossom cakes and came to Lu Jing's courtyard with Lu Yi.
This small courtyard located in the west courtyard of the Shenxiao Prefecture is much quieter and shabbier than the other courtyards of the Lu family's children in the mansion.
There is only a pine tree at the door.
But this pine tree is different from other trees that are dying day by day. The leaves are still shiny, just like a pagoda, standing there majestically.
Shengzi and Lu Yi were obviously not interested in this pine tree.
Lu Yi actually complained about Shengzi's plan to give the precious and delicious peach blossom cake to Lu Jing.
Since this peach blossom cake was originally given to Shengzi by Mrs. Ning, she couldn't say anything.
But he was still mumbling: "The peach blossom cake is so precious, wouldn't it be a pity to give it to Lu Jing..."
Sheng Zi obviously didn't care much about Lu Yi's complaints, but looked towards the small courtyard.
The courtyard door was not closed tightly.
From a very long distance, through the cracks of the tung tree barrier used to hide the ugly face, Shengzi could clearly see the scene in the courtyard.
There are many flowers and plants transplanted from unknown places planted in the small courtyard, and a maid is leaning over to take care of them.
These flowers and plants are not expensive, but they are well taken care of and grow extremely vigorously. Even in late autumn, there are still flowers in bloom, bringing a bit of warmth to the old courtyard.
In the small courtyard, there are also stone tables and benches that can be seen everywhere in the west courtyard.
"Lu Jing is practicing calligraphy?"
Shengzi saw Lu Jing's figure in front of the stone table and became curious.
Lu Yi, who was on the side, suddenly laughed and said, "I see that my father always takes a shower and changes clothes before writing, and he is very calm and focused. His desk is spotless."
"But this Lu Jing is so good, he writes while eating."
And just like Lu Yi said.
Next to a piece of tissue paper, there was also a plate of ordinary green vegetables.
Every time Lu Jing writes a few words, he passes the brush to his left hand, picks up the chopsticks and takes a few bites, looking very casual.
Shengzi doesn't care about this.
Even her father once taught Shengzi to have a reverence for knowledge.
However, Shengzi came here for her own purpose, and other people's actions had nothing to do with her, so she naturally wouldn't judge anything.
"Lu Yi, I want to ask you, Third Brother Jing, today. Don't make him angry by being neither big nor small."
Lu Yi was slightly startled, with some doubts in his eyes.
Is Lu Jing looking for beauty?
The Sheng family has astonishing power in Taixuan Capital.
Sheng Zi's father is the Second Assistant Minister of the Taishu Pavilion. He plays a very important role in the court. It is not an exaggeration to say that he has all-powerful power and can call upon the wind and rain.
With such a grand appearance as the lintel, what do you want from Lu Jing?
"How can Lu Jing help you? Sister Sheng, why don't you tell me the reason and I will think of something for you?"
Sheng Zi shook her head and said: "Many things are hard to come by, and those that can be easily found are not precious."
Lu Yi seemed to understand. Her two ponytails were still dangling behind her head. She came to her senses and raised her chin: "In that case, Sister Sheng might as well leave this matter to me. I have always been effective in speaking in the house."
"Sister Sheng just needs to tell me what you want from Lu Jing. I told Lu Jing that he wouldn't dare not give it."
When Lu Yi spoke, there was a sly look in his eyes.
Shengzi frowned.
A look of displeasure appeared on his originally heroic face.
"Lu Yi." Sheng Zi said seriously: "Yesterday Mrs. Zhong took the exam for your third brother Jing. I observed that his words and deeds were extraordinary and had a lot of sharpness.
I feel that although he is not favored in the Lu family, he is not a weak young man who can be humiliated at will.
Moreover, he is your brother, so it is inappropriate for you to be so arrogant in front of him. "Lu Yi was obviously stunned when he heard Sheng Zi's solemn words.
Sheng Zi did not give her another chance to speak. As she walked towards the small courtyard, she said to Lu Yi: "When you enter the courtyard, don't make any sound."
Lu Yi came back to her senses, her eyes clearly showing some dissatisfaction, but she was unwilling to refute Sheng Zi, so she could only follow Sheng Zi dejectedly.
When the two came to the door, Lu Jing was still immersed in writing.
The slightly faded brush felt quite pleasant as it moved across the paper.
"Master, someone is coming to the door."
Qing Yue, who was lowering her head to take care of the flowers and plants, saw Sheng Zi and Lu Yi.
He quickly dusted off the dust on his hands and stood up.
At this time, it was Lu Jing's final touch.
He took a long breath, put down the brush in his hand, and then looked up at the door.
When the door opened, Lu Jing certainly noticed someone coming at the door.
It's just that he has already finished writing the last line of poetry. The "Cao Sheng Zhang Xu" cursive script he practiced in his previous life also emphasizes writing every time he writes, so he never stopped writing.
"Qingyue, make tea."
Lu Jing called out, Qing Yue saluted the visitor from a distance, then walked into the back room to make tea.
"Sister Lu Yi, bring the guests in."
Lu Jing nodded towards Lu Yi and spoke very naturally.
Shengzi suddenly felt dumb.
Lu Jing's tone was calm, but there was a hint of the majesty of an elder.
The same was true for Lu Yi. She opened her mouth, but for a moment she didn't know what to say in reply.
In this Lu Mansion, Lu Yi and her third cousin had never communicated.
Even when he was a playful child, he followed the other brothers and sisters and set a boundary with Lu Jing. At most, he only laughed a few words when Lu Jing was bullied.
But what Lu Yi didn't expect was that Lu Jing's words "sister" would be so natural and natural in his tone.
It's like... Lu Jing's role in the mansion on weekdays is indeed that of a trusted elder brother.
"This Lu Jing is so strange...who is her sister?"
Lu Yi curled her lips and was about to say something.
Sheng Zi suddenly took a step forward and said to Lu Yi: "Lu Yi, you are the host, why don't you introduce me?"
Lu Yi was immediately discouraged and reluctantly said: "Lu Jing, this is Sister Shengzi from the Sheng Mansion at the end of Changning Street, ten miles away."
"Grand appearance?" Lu Jing's expression remained unchanged as he invited the two girls into the room.
But he was speculating in his mind.
"So it turns out that the girl in red with Lu Yi is not Nan Heyu? On that day, did Miss Nanfu come to the house yesterday?"
"What's the matter with this beautiful girl coming to see me?"
The majestic appearance at this moment has never been matched with a veil.
She is tall and slender, with creamy skin, bright and white teeth, and a long whip with green light wrapped around her waist, which makes her look extremely pleasing to the eye.
What is different from other girls in their prime is that there is a sharpness in her majestic appearance, and there is no weakness between her eyebrows, but a trace of heroism.
"Hey... was this character written by Mr. Jing?"
While Lu Jing was thinking, Sheng Zi and Lu Yi had already walked to the stone table. They originally wanted to cross the stone table and walk into the house.
Just when passing by the stone table, Shengzi caught a glimpse of the straw paper spread by Lu Jing on the table.
I saw a few lines of words written on the piece of paper.
Although the pen and ink are occasionally erratic, if you look closely, the handwriting is like a tiger lying down and rising like a dancing dragon.
Sheng Zi didn't know calligraphy, but she felt that the ink on the papyrus paper was born with an amazing sense of beauty.
However, in Shengzi's eyes, the calligraphy was secondary. What really caught her attention was those few lines of text.
[Those who teach me good things are my thieves, and those who teach me evil things are my teachers.
When you meet a knight on the road, you must present your sword, but if you are not a talented person, don't present a poem.
If three people are walking together, there must be my teacher.
Choose the good ones and follow them, and change the bad ones. 】
Just four lines of pen and ink made Shengzi open her eyes wide and carefully comprehend the deep meaning.
In a blink of an eye, how manyThe break time has passed.
Sheng Zi was still murmuring the sentence "Every knight on the road must present his sword, but if he is not a talented man, he should not present his poems."
"When you meet a knight on the road, you should offer your sword. Don't recite poems to those without talent."
These four sentences seem to be full of philosophy of life, mixed with extremely romantic and free-spirited chivalrous feelings.
Ling, who was already good at martial arts and naturally free and easy, particularly liked her.
"When I saw these four sentences in the article today, it was a worthwhile trip."
Sheng Zi's eyes were clear, and she couldn't help but feel a little regretful in her heart: "I don't know which classic this wise saying comes from. I only saw it today, which is my regret."
"Lu Jing's writing of these four lines also means that his state of mind is roughly the same.
There is a sense of freedom and ease in the rationality, and there is also a sense of respect for the virtuous knights. "
"And this handwriting is also extremely extraordinary..."
As Shengzi's thoughts surged, she saw the plate of green vegetables placed on the table.
The pens and paper used to practice calligraphy are also very cheap.
"I don't know how long this writing brush has been used. The barrel of the writing brush has faded, turned white, and is slightly bent. The writing brush used for calligraphy is not river silk paper from Beiluo Road, nor is it even Liu Xuan paper. It is just the straw paper used by ordinary people for reading."
"And that plate of vegetables..."
Sheng Zi sighed in her heart, this paper, pen, and vegetables wouldn't be anything special if they were placed in ordinary people's homes.
But this is the Jiuhu Lu Mansion, and the biological father of the young man in front of him is Lu Shenyuan, the general of Shenxiao who was famous when he was young and was known as the first storm in Jiuhu.
With these identities in the background, Shengzi finally understood how difficult Lu Jing's situation was.
"Miss Sheng...Miss Shengzi?"
"Sister Sheng!"
Lu Jing and Lu Yi's soft calls brought Sheng Zi back to her senses.
Lu Jing and him remained calm.
Lu Yi was a little confused.
Sister Sheng...what's going on?
"I lost my mind."
The grand appearance is very natural, without any embarrassment.
She turned her head and stared into Lu Jing's eyes, suddenly smiled and said: "When I saw these four lines of article today, I just felt quite fond of them.
I hope I can ask Mr. Jing for this piece of writing. It would be best if I could ask him to indicate the source. I will surely be rewarded for my graceful appearance. "
With a graceful appearance, he asked for this piece of papyrus.
Lu Jing was in trouble.
"Indicate the source? Is there a "Zengguang Xianwen" in this world?"
Seeing Lu Jing's hesitation, Lu Yi was speechless: "Lu Jing, it's just a piece of paper. Are you still reluctant to part with it? If you are reluctant to part with it, I have some fine river silk paper..."
Lu Yi's originally arrogant words suddenly became less and less confident as he spoke, and his voice gradually became quieter.
Because at some point, Lu Jing had turned his head slightly, his expression did not change at all, he just stared into Lu Yi's eyes.
At this moment, Lu Yi didn't know why, but he could no longer maintain the arrogance, arrogance, and aggressiveness that came from an immature girl.
Her voice became smaller and smaller until she finished speaking and lowered her head.
Lu Jing smiled and said to Sheng Zi beside him: "It's not that he is reluctant to part with a piece of papyrus... it's just the source..."
When he said this, he shook his head slightly, picked up the brush next to him, and carefully dipped it in ink.
On the far left it says…
"From "Zengguang Xianwen"."
